en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of an elaborate Baroque palace complex along a water-filled moat or canal. A long façade with many identical arched windows and rich sculptural decoration runs horizontally across the image. On the right stands an ornate pavilion with a tall, onion‑shaped crown dome topped by a large crown. In the foreground a wooden pedestrian bridge crosses the water, with people standing or walking on it. Trees are visible to the left and the sky is partly cloudy.
